overview.summary: PowerShell ISE All Breakpoints Removed. This Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell record is emitted to Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational; provider metadata classifies it as level Information, task PowerShell ISE Operation. Analyst field shape: no EventData fields.
